nodes.label: ADR-0001 Delete DamageComponent with Issue Module
nodes.norm_label: adr-0001 delete damagecomponent with issue module

nodes.label: Delete DamageComponent in the Issue module pass
nodes.rationale: Keeping DamageComponent as a private UI adapter would leave the avoided name on the selection seam and a second mutable tree beside the immutable catalog. The picker is rewritten with Issue-owned nodes plus a selected set of path identities rather than adapted in place.
nodes.norm_label: delete damagecomponent in the issue module pass

nodes.label: Issue module
nodes.rationale: Owns the catalog tree and recorded projection; converts Flag to Path; display uses Issue.labels(from: flags).

nodes.label: DamageComponent
nodes.rationale: Deleted rather than kept as an internal adapter. Future reviews must not reintroduce a parallel selectable tree.

nodes.label: Immutable Issue catalog
nodes.rationale: A second mutable tree beside the immutable catalog was the cost of keeping DamageComponent as an adapter.

nodes.label: Report owns a stored-method ZIP writer
nodes.rationale: ZIPFoundation would pull an SPM package into a CocoaPods app for STORE-only archives. Compression.framework cannot write ZIP. Report writes local file headers, central directory, end-of-central-directory, uncompressed entries, and CRC-32. Compressed ZIP would be a new decision.
nodes.norm_label: report owns a stored-method zip writer

nodes.label: CSV companionData ZIP
nodes.rationale: Must be a real ZIP when photos exist. Photos are uncompressed in the archive. Missing ZIP companion still does not fail CSV.

nodes.label: ZIPFoundation
nodes.rationale: Rejected: would add an SPM package to a CocoaPods app for STORE-only archives. Do not add a zip package for this companion.

nodes.label: Compression.framework
nodes.rationale: Rejected because it cannot write ZIP.

nodes.label: Stored-method ZIP writer
nodes.rationale: Hand-rolled STORE ZIP: local file headers, central directory, EOCD, uncompressed entries, CRC-32. No ZIPFoundation, no new CocoaPods.

nodes.label: Snapshots at the Report export seam
nodes.rationale: Keeping [Inspection] on export leaves Core Data on the interface: every Report change still pays the entity tax, and the join rule stays coupled to objectID. Snapshots make join identity customer id + site, keep Issue label/sort rules inside Report via Issue.Path, and let export tests construct rows by hand. Report does not import Core Data.
nodes.norm_label: snapshots at the report export seam

nodes.label: ReportSnapshot
nodes.rationale: Value type of grouped inspection snapshots: customer identity and site, date, InspectionItem rows with Issue paths and photo bytes. Callers and tests learn this type, not the Core Data graph.

nodes.label: Inspection entity
nodes.rationale: Rejected at the export seam. Do not add export([Inspection]) beside snapshot export.

nodes.label: Report snapshot mapper
nodes.rationale: A mapper outside Report is the production adapter from entities to snapshots.

nodes.label: canJoin
nodes.rationale: Combined PDF join is enforced on snapshots; the screen may call canJoin to skip the layout sheet.

nodes.label: Snapshot export seam
nodes.rationale: Infrastructure and Core Data stay behind a value-type seam so Report, tests, and join rules do not depend on entities or objectID.

nodes.label: Session id vs LastUser id on UserManager
nodes.rationale: Keeping email and isLoggedIn as Session, or leaving Face ID on session email, tangles 'am I logged in?' with 'who was here last' and prevents logout from clearing Session honestly. Logged in means a Session id is present. Logout keeps LastUser; login and account create replace it; wipe clears both through UserManager.
nodes.norm_label: session id vs lastuser id on usermanager

nodes.label: Session
nodes.rationale: The logged-in user's id. Callers may read it; only UserManager writes it. Do not store session email or an isLoggedIn bool.

nodes.label: LastUser
nodes.rationale: User id of the last account that held a Session, used for Face ID after logout. Do not treat LastUser as logged in.

nodes.label: UserManager
nodes.rationale: Owns Session and LastUser. Wipe calls UserManager, not a blanket key delete. Screens do not read UserDefaults Session or LastUser keys.

nodes.label: UserDefaults
nodes.rationale: Tests inject UserDefaults rather than writing sessionUserId. Screens do not read Session or LastUser keys.

nodes.label: Intake
nodes.rationale: Rejected option: Session id passed into Intake instead of read from UserManager.

nodes.label: Photo bytes at the InspectionItem seam
nodes.rationale: Dual packing of (data, urlPath) just moves the problem; CloudKit already wants blobs. Bytes in, bytes out; documents files are a private read fallback. Do not expose photoData(at:), photoURLString(at:), or setPackedPhotos. Do not write documents files from Intake. CoreDataManager must not name photoURL…photoURL5.
nodes.norm_label: photo bytes at the inspectionitem seam

nodes.label: setPackedPhotos
nodes.rationale: Rejected public write path. Slot keys and documents paths stay in the implementation.

nodes.label: photoURL slots
nodes.rationale: Rejected: CoreDataManager must not name photoURL…photoURL5; fetch items with local files through InspectionItem.

nodes.label: Bytes in, bytes out
nodes.rationale: Public seam is replacePhotos([Data]) and photoBytes(). Files are a private read fallback. Five-photo cap stays on InspectionItem.

nodes.label: One InspectionItem form screen owns chrome and persist
nodes.rationale: Two shallow hosts that embed the shared form and call Intake were pass-through: persist bounced across four modules. Customer already collapsed Add/Edit the same way. Sequence is assigned at Intake create, not counted on the ViewModel. Do not restore InspectionFormViewController or InspectionItemEditViewController. Do not put FormState persist on the ViewModel.
nodes.norm_label: one inspectionitem form screen owns chrome and persist

nodes.label: InspectionItemFormViewController
nodes.rationale: Single screen for create (viewModel:) and edit (inspectionItem:). Owns create footer, edit save bar, and InspectionItemIntake calls.

nodes.label: InspectionFormViewModel
nodes.rationale: Keeps inspection-row lifecycle only: open a row, finish, abandon if empty. Tests hit the ViewModel for identity and abandon, not addItem.

nodes.label: InspectionItemIntake
nodes.rationale: Create assigns sequence next after existing items. Tests hit Intake for persist and sequence.

nodes.label: InspectionFormViewController
nodes.rationale: Deleted host. Do not restore.

nodes.label: InspectionItemEditViewController
nodes.rationale: Deleted host. Do not restore.

nodes.label: Customer Add/Edit collapse
nodes.rationale: Precedent: Customer already collapsed Add/Edit into one form screen the same way InspectionItem now does.

nodes.label: Selected Inspections reach Report through ReportFromInspections
nodes.rationale: export([Inspection]) on ReportGenerator reopens ADR-0003. Growing the mapper into the orchestrator makes mapping own hop and selection. ReportFromInspections applies empty-selection, hops to a background context, maps snapshots, and calls snapshot export. Do not hop or map on ReportViewController.
nodes.norm_label: selected inspections reach report through reportfrominspections

nodes.label: ReportFromInspections
nodes.rationale: Empty-selection: PDF first row, CSV all. Hop is not injected. Snapshot export tests stay at Report.

nodes.label: ReportViewController
nodes.rationale: Keeps pick, one canJoin to skip the PDF sheet, share, and two empty-list alert strings. Header, sort, date-range, and layout stay gathered on the screen.

nodes.label: ReportGenerator
nodes.rationale: Rejected option: export([Inspection]) on ReportGenerator. Join is still enforced inside snapshot export.

nodes.label: ReportSnapshotMapper
nodes.rationale: Rejected option: grow the mapper into the orchestrator.

nodes.label: canJoin Selection
nodes.rationale: Takes the same Selection (PDF-first, photos off) so the screen can skip the layout sheet without mapping.

nodes.label: Paths at the InspectionItem Issue seam
nodes.rationale: Keeping issueFlagMap/applyIssueFlags public, or routing Report and CustomerDetails through Intake, leaves Flag wiring on every caller and pulls FormState into Report. Paths on InspectionItem match photo bytes. Do not expose issueFlagMap/applyIssueFlags. Issue still converts Flag to Path.
nodes.norm_label: paths at the inspectionitem issue seam

nodes.label: issueFlagMap
nodes.rationale: Rejected public API along with applyIssueFlags. Flag KVC and Core Data bools stay in the implementation.

nodes.label: createLoad in front of CloudKit and in-memory adapters
nodes.rationale: Deleting api.ts and leaving joins in cloudkitApi keeps CD_ and REFERENCE filters on the load interface, and tests stop at codecs. Two adapters make the seam real. Do not import queryRecords/CD_ from pages. Do not keep a pass-through customersAPI. InspectionItem carries inspectionId so joins are not Core Data REFERENCES.
nodes.norm_label: createload in front of cloudkit and in-memory adapters

nodes.label: createLoad
nodes.rationale: Join, sort, and missing-id throws live in this module. Pages load Customer, Inspection, and InspectionItem through it.

nodes.label: CloudKit JS adapter
nodes.rationale: CloudKit JS plus codecs are one adapter. Codec tests stay on this adapter.

nodes.label: In-memory load adapter
nodes.rationale: In-memory map adapter. Load tests use this adapter.

nodes.label: api.ts
nodes.rationale: Rejected in-process collapse into cloudkitApi.

nodes.label: inspectionId join
nodes.rationale: Lists keep customerId only; inspectionById attaches Customer and items. InspectionItem carries inspectionId so joins are not Core Data REFERENCES.

nodes.label: Web load adapter seam
nodes.rationale: Entity-yielding adapters behind createLoad isolate CloudKit codecs and CD_ filters from pages.

nodes.label: SiteRacking JSON and SiteDocuments on Customer
nodes.rationale: Optional warehouse profile is not an Inspection snapshot, not Issue damage, and not InspectionItem pre-fill. Five binary slots bloat the Customer CloudKit record when one PDF changes; spec rows are never queried across customers. JSON for the small profile and separate records for files match photos: bytes in, bytes out, no slot keys. Empty profile is nil JSON, not {}. Do not add SiteRacking fields to ReportSnapshot or the web customer codec this pass. Do not reuse Issue upright/beam/deck flags for catalog specs.
nodes.norm_label: siteracking json and sitedocuments on customer

nodes.label: Customer
nodes.rationale: One Customer is one site. Owns SiteRacking JSON and SiteDocument records.

nodes.label: SiteRacking
nodes.rationale: Installed uprights/beams/decks plus blueprints encoded as one optional JSON blob on Customer.

nodes.label: SiteDocument
nodes.rationale: To-many entity with bytes and filename, cap five. Callers use documentFiles() / replaceDocuments. Keep-by-id must not rewrite data on a name-only save.

nodes.label: CatalogName
nodes.rationale: Manufacturer and DeckType names scoped to the Session user. Catalogs are this inspector's list, not a public CloudKit catalog. Rejected: JSON catalogs on User.

nodes.label: Hybrid JSON plus SiteDocument persist
nodes.rationale: JSON for the small warehouse profile; separate to-many records for files; CatalogName rows for manufacturer/deck type. Avoids slot bloat and an unqueried spec-row graph.
